fix.pr_body:
## What was missing

The head-to-head page showed opponent match stats (# matches, record, win %) but not the opponent's Elo rating, making it harder to contextualise results against stronger or weaker opponents.

## What changed

- **`decksite/data/person.py`** — added `opp.elo` to the `SELECT` in `load_head_to_head` so the field is returned by the API.
- **`decksite/data/clauses.py`** — added `'elo': 'opp.elo'` to the `head_to_head_order_by` sort_options dict so the column is sortable.
- **`shared_web/static/js/headtoheadtable.jsx`** — added an Elo `<th>` (with sort binding) to `renderHeaderRow` and an `entry.elo` `<td>` to `renderRow`, following the same pattern as `persontable.jsx`.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks).
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 848 passed, 1 skipped (no DB-dependent head-to-head tests exist; the change is purely additive SQL + JSX).

Fixes #7998
